sample_unit: webpages (50 prevention, 49 treatment) compared descriptively with ChatGPT-generated text

links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT-generated kidney stone information versus existing webpages
links.effect: Existing webpages read at a 10th to 12th grade level. ChatGPT text was considerably easier to understand, with readability as low as 5th grade.
links.quote: The text generated by ChatGPT was considerably easier to understand with readability levels measured as low as 5th grade.

unlisted_practices: Using generative AI to rewrite or produce patient education material at a lower reading level than existing web content

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and quality of ChatGPT-generated patient health information for kidney stones compared to online search results, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
